title: What Backtesting Actually Is
hook: Finding winners on a finished chart isn’t a test.

launchpad.outcome: Feel the difference between review and a backtest, then lock the rules for your first study.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Am I testing my rules, or finding winners?

slides.title: Find a winner
lines: The whole session is visible. Scroll it and pick the trade you’d take.
after: Now reset: the future disappears. Deciding without it is the backtest.

slides.title: Test the rules, not the past
lines: Apply the same rules to historical price, every time. You’re testing the rules, not hunting winners.
cards: Dayli ICC version · your rulebook version

slides.title: Set up your first study
lines: Fill it in, then lock it. Every rep is tested against these rules.

slides.title: Now try changing a rule
lines: Pretend you’re 20 reps in and unhappy. Change the stop rule, then press Save changes.
slides.principle: Don’t change the test because you don’t like the results so far.

takeaways: Review is picking winners on a finished chart. A backtest decides without the future.
Lock the study rules before the first rep.
A rule change mid-study makes a new version.
remember: Don’t change the test because you don’t like the results so far.
